higher_line_rule: last two confirmed high pivots form resistance and last two confirmed low pivots form support; project to current day/week from only prior completed higher-timeframe bars
entry: EMA25 0.5 ATR first-touch signal on closed 1H/4H bar, near projected support with EMA slope bending up for long, or near projected resistance with EMA slope bending down for short; fill next open
exit: opposite EMA25 first-touch signal closes the current side even if higher-line filter blocks the replacement entry
control: same EMA25 0.5 ATR signal without higher-line filter, identical candles and costs
primary_screen: each symbol/timeframe/variant needs at least 100 closed trades; report every rolling 100-trade window and nonoverlapping block with net PnL, winning trades, win rate, profit factor and elapsed days; monthly/yearly tables diagnostic only
annual_screen: diagnostic only; no calendar-year profitability gate
annual_ex_post_regime: stock return from first open to last close: growth > +10%, decline < -10%, sideways when absolute return <=10% and high-low range <=30% of first open, otherwise volatile_mixed; diagnostic only
candidate_policy: no strategy or paper account without at least one complete 100-trade window on selected pair, cost review and manual TradingView reconciliation
universe_selection: Top 100 SECTYPE 1/2 TQBR stocks by median close*volume of last 60 daily bars in fixed 2026-10-30 snapshot, requiring >=150 distinct 1H dates in each of 2024 and 2025, observed January and December in both years; no profitability input
prior_pilot_seen: The 10-symbol pilot and its result were inspected before this 100-symbol expansion; all results are exploratory seen_history
prior_full100_seen: Earlier full100 selected by turnover without year-coverage requirement was inspected; this complete-year cohort is an exploratory data-quality revision, not an untouched holdout
monthly_ex_post_regime: stock return from first open to last close: growth > +5%, decline < -5%, sideways when absolute return <=5% and high-low range <=10% of first open, otherwise volatile_mixed; diagnostic only
regime_definition_record: Documentation corrected after run to match the already executed monthly_efficiency.py formulas; no calculations, candidate decisions or performance values changed.
original_primary_screen: strictly positive return in every complete calendar month and fewer closed trades than EMA25 control (superseded after reviewing first results)
screen_amendment: After full results were seen, owner rejected the all-month-positive requirement and chose month-by-month deal counts, wins, win rate and PnL as diagnostics. This is an exploratory retrospective rescreen, not a precommitted validation.
screen_amendment_2: After seeing the month-level results, owner changed the principal unit to 100 consecutive closed trades. This is a retrospective exploratory rescreen, not a frozen out-of-sample validation.
original_annual_screen: strictly positive return in each complete calendar year; incomplete 2026 shown separately
